svg.title: Agentic SRE workflow
svg.desc: Planned agentic SRE workflow: Observe (Read-scoped MCP), then Investigate (LangGraph + RAG), then Evaluate (OPA policy checks), then Approve (Human confirmation), then Act (Temporal workflows). In development; not a deployed production system. dark theme.
svg.text: AN INTENDED OPERATING MODEL, NOT A DEPLOYED PRODUCTION SYSTEM · HUMANS APPROVE PRODUCTION CHANGES
